metadata.name: Antarctic sediment‑core depth, age & SST measurements (2019) (based on columns and first‑row values)
metadata.description: Based on the dataset columns and tool outputs, this collection contains 150 sediment‑core records collected at a single Antarctic location (≈ -56.1512° lat, -115.1341° lon) between 2019‑05‑31T15:15:00+00:00 and 2019‑06‑05T15:30:00+00:00. Each record provides identifiers (Event, Sample label), sediment depth, geological age (Ma), cluster assignment, sea‑surface temperature (°C) with its standard deviation, and elevation (depth below sea level).
metadata.spatial: point locations (~10 m precision) (derived from 5‑decimal‑place latitude/longitude precision)
metadata.temporal: sub‑second granularity (based on parse_success_rate = 1.0 and apparent_granularity = sub‑second from analyze_temporal_column)
